premises.text: Nonprofits still run core processes on pen and paper despite a huge sector
premises.evidence_span: Many still rely on pen and paper for core processes like scheduling, volunteer tracking, and even donations

premises.text: Mobile geofencing, kiosk mode, and admin check-in automate volunteer hour tracking with almost no staff work
premises.evidence_span: It required no work from the Habitat staff. It was simple, easy, and efficient

premises.text: Engagement data is a key impact metric nonprofits share with foundations and donors
premises.evidence_span: This critical information is used by nonprofits to understand the level of engagement of their volunteers and is a key impact metric used to share with both foundations and donors

premises.text: Micro-donations at peak inspiration, informed by volunteer data and corporate matching, convert volunteers to donors
premises.evidence_span: By leveraging our volunteer data, we can tell nonprofits when to give, how much to give, and what to say

premises.text: Unlike competitors siloed by nonprofit, volunteer, or corporate buyers, Civic Champs' stack enables seamless cross-party data sharing
premises.evidence_span: Unlike these competitors, Civic Champs has a database and technology architecture that's uniquely built to serve the full market

premises.text: Subscription pricing from $25 to $450/month targets the nonprofit CRM market and adjacent industries
premises.evidence_span: Civic Champs is targeting the $1.7 billion CRM market for nonprofits
